metadata.description: Claude Code mods for Android and Kotlin Multiplatform development.

plugins.name: build-output-distiller
plugins.description: Turns Gradle output into a short digest of errors with file:line lists and fix hints, and flags a failure that repeats.

plugins.name: android-logcat
plugins.description: Bounds the model's adb logcat calls, redacts secrets from adb output, and keeps a pid-scoped logcat buffer with a grep tool and a /logcat pane.

plugins.name: android-device-console
plugins.description: Live device toggles, Doze and standby controls, a WorkManager job runner, and the device state in the system prompt.

plugins.name: android-project-lens
plugins.description: A navigation route index, Compose stability reports on demand, and the real manifest SDKs and permissions for the model.
